这标志着 28 年来美国汽车制造商首次获得这一称号。特斯拉在美国的汽车销量比宝马多 158,612 辆。
https://t.co/3O15XMOr2s

tweets.text: “The Tesla Autopilot AI team, it’s about 150 engineers, and they’re outperforming teams that they’re competing against that are 3,000 engineers.” - @elonmusk https://t.co/bLApxEGru1
tweets.text_zh: “特斯拉 Autopilot AI 团队约有 150 名工程师，他们的表现优于竞争对手的 3,000 名工程师团队。” - @elonmusk https://t.co/bLApxEGru1

tweets.text: .@elonmusk: “My kids were basically educated by Reddit & YouTube; Let’s just get a bunch of content creators that we think are cool on YouTube & say, “Hey, would you consider putting your content on Twitter, & we’ll pay you 10% more than YouTube & see how it goes?” Let’s do that”
tweets.text_zh: .@elonmusk：“我的孩子基本上是通过 Reddit 和 YouTube 接受教育的；让我们找一群我们认为在 YouTube 上很酷的内容创作者来说，“嘿，你能考虑把你的内容放在 Twitter 上吗？我们会付给你比 YouTube 高 10% 的钱，看看效果如何？”让我们这样做”

BREAKING: Tesla CEO Elon Musk gave Biden's Secretary of Labor Marty Walsh a tour of his company's nearly-completed $1.1 billion factory near Austin, Texas yesterday.

Elon & Marty had a 75-minute conversation about  inflation, American innovation and job creation in Texas. https://t.co/ycJXp5gu3M
tweets.text_zh:
突发新闻：昨天，特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 带领拜登的劳工部长马蒂·沃尔什 (Marty Walsh) 参观了该公司位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀附近即将竣工、耗资 11 亿美元的工厂。

Elon 和 Marty 就通货膨胀、美国创新和德克萨斯州创造就业机会进行了 75 分钟的对话。 https://t.co/ycJXp5gu3M
